description:
Xebia is a global AI-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 16 countries, we help organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data-driven solutions. 

We specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data and Cloud, Intelligent Automation, and Digital Products, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on engineering excellence and a people-first culture.  

In the CEE region, we’re a team of nearly 1,000 experts delivering modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as McLaren, Aviva, Deloitte, Spotify, Disney, ING, UPS, Tesco, Truecaller, AllSaints, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, Allegro, InPost, and many, many more. We work with leading technologies including AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, and Snowflake, and combine strong engineering culture with a consulting mindset and a continuous focus on growth and knowledge sharing. 

About project:

The client is a global management consulting organization operating at enterprise scale, supporting complex IT operations across multiple regions. They deliver high-impact digital, technology, and operations services for large international organizations, with a strong focus on automation, reliability, and data-driven decision-making.

You will be:

  • architecting and managing cloud infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure,
  • deploying and running Kubernetes clusters using Helm and GitOps practices,
  • automating infrastructure provisioning with Terraform,
  • implementing CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows,
  • containerizing applications with Docker and Kubernetes and managing their scalability,
  • providing build and run support, including deployments, troubleshooting, and performance tuning,
  • independently scoping, planning, and delivering complex projects,
  • engaging in architectural discussions, managing platform operations, and contributing to capacity forecasting,
  • designing, developing, and deploying AI systems into production, preferably in Python,
  • building and integrating APIs and services that expose AI capabilities,
  • working with LLMs, traditional ML models, and data pipelines,
  • designing and developing agent systems using LangGraph or similar frameworks.

Your profile:

  • proven experience in DevOps or platform engineering, with hands-on work on AWS, GCP, or Azure,
  • practical experience running Kubernetes in production, including Helm and GitOps,
  • strong experience with Terraform and infrastructure provisioning automation,
  • experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows,
  • solid experience with Docker and containerized application delivery,
  • proficiency in Python,
  • experience taking AI systems into production, including working with LLMs, ML models, and data pipelines,
  • experience designing agent systems with LangGraph or similar frameworks,
  • familiarity with Claude Code and skill-based agentic systems,
  • cloud DevOps certifications (AWS/GCP) or similar credentials,
  • ability to own tasks end to end, with the autonomy to scope, plan, and deliver complex projects,
  • a background that spans DevOps and Full Stack/AI engineering, with a move from one to the other being ideal.

Nice to have:

  • experience developing backend services in Python, Node.js, or similar,
  • experience building frontend interfaces with React, Next.js, or similar,
  • experience integrating frontend, backend, and AI components into a seamless product.

Recruitment Process:

CV review – HR call – Interview – Client Interview – Decision
